snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy Beta Gameplay Trailer | Warhammer Skulls 2026
snippet.description:
Owlcat Games, alongside the launch of the beta, is showcasing a new gameplay trailer for the upcoming Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy, narrated by Saro, a sanctioned psyker in your retinue. Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grimdark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy.

Join the Inquisition:
Wishlist Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710600/Warhammer_40000_Dark_Heresy/
https://store.epicgames.com/p/warhammer-40k-dark-heresy-4cf5b0
https://www.gog.com/en/game/warhammer_40000_dark_heresy
https://www.xbox.com/nl-NL/games/store/warhammer-40-000-dark-heresy/9p1j4tl3m04q
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014065

Become a founder and get access to the beta of Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy through the website:
https://darkheresy.owlcat.games/

See all the Skulls 2026 reveals on Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/2eknkrto/skulls-2026-the-warhammer-video-games-festival/

Follow for more Warhammer, more often:

- Sign up for Warhammer+: https://www.warhammerplus.com/
